[S011] Conference Operator [V004] [367]: Good morning and welcome to Paychex's third quarter fiscal [V005] 2026 earnings call.

[S012] Operator [V006] [388]: Participating on the call today are John Gibson and Bob Schrader. [S013] Following the speaker's prepared remarks, There will be a question and answer period. [S014] If you would like to ask a question during this time, simply press star, then the number one on your telephone keypad. [S015] If you would like to withdraw your question, please press star two on your telephone keypad. [S016] As a reminder, this conference is being recorded and your participation implies consent to our recording of this call. [S017] I would now like to turn the call over to Bob Schrader, Paychex's Chief Financial Officer.

[S018] Bob Schrader [V007] [425]: Thank you for joining us to discuss Paychex's third quarter fiscal [V008] 2026 results. [S019] Our earnings release and presentation are available on our investor relations website. [S020] We plan to file our form [V009] 10Q within a couple of business days. [S021] This call is being webcast live and will be available for replay on our investor relations portal. [S022] Today's call includes forward-looking statements that refer to future events and involve some risk. [S023] We encourage you to review our filings with the SEC for additional information on factors that could cause actual results to differ from our current expectations. [S024] We will also reference non-GAAP financial measures. [S025] Description of these items along with the reconciliation of non-GAAP measures can be found in our earnings release. [S026] I would now like to turn the call over to John Gibson, Paychex President and CEO.

[S027] John Gibson [V010] [474]: Thanks, Bob. [S028] Hello, everyone. [S029] I'll cover this quarter's operational highlights, and Bob will come back and discuss our financial results and outlook, and then we'll open it up for your questions. [S030] We delivered a strong quarter with revenue up [V011] 20% and adjusted operating income up [V012] 22% year-over-year, driven by effective execution and progress advancing our strategic priorities, most notably the pay core integration and acceleration of our transformational AI initiatives. [S031] In this very dynamic environment, financial strength is important, and our free cash flow generation continues to be robust, as Bob will highlight later. [S032] Amid a dynamic macro backdrop, our clients' workforce levels remained stable, supported by our solutions that help manage costs and source talent in a tight labor market. [S033] In a highly regulated industry, our compliance depth advisory expertise and award-winning platforms provide a clear competitive advantage in navigating a constantly changing and complex regulatory environment. [S034] As we embed AI into our expert-enabled technology, we are strengthening that advantage by leveraging our vast data to scale our expertise, enhance productivity, and elevate client outcomes. [S035] As you all know, we operate in HR, benefits, and payroll, some of the most mission critical aspects of a business. [S036] And we are honored that [V013] 800,000 clients rely on us for trusted support and advice. [S037] For many of our clients, we effectively serve as their HR department, managing a foundational part of their business, their people. [S038] Heirs paying employees, withholding taxes, or administrating benefits carry significant regulatory and reputational risk, driving demand for trusted compliance solutions where accuracy matters most. [S039] Demand for our comprehensive advisory and benefit solutions remains strong, differentiating us from the tech-only providers. [S040] Clients are increasingly turning to our HR professionals for strategic advisory expertise. [S041] and assistance over routine transactional support. [S042] Robust revenue growth in retirement, ASO, and PO highlights the durability of our model and reinforces our expectations of a long secular growth runway for these businesses. [S043] Our ASO and PO worksite employee growth continues to outpace the industry, reflecting our value in navigating regulatory complexity and ensuring compliance often for clients with no or, as I said, limited HR support. [S044] Our PO business remains strong with high single-digit worksite employee growth driven by robust demand and record retention rates. [S045] Our PO solution empowers small businesses to offer competitive benefit packages on par with Fortune [V014] 500 companies, aiding talent attraction and retention in a tight labor market. [S046] January enrollment in our at-risk Florida MPP medical plan went well and in line with our expectations, helping drive sequential revenue growth. [S047] We received positive feedback on the new AI-driven benefits intelligence we embedded in the enrollment workflow this year. [S048] It leverages employee-specific data to recommend plan choices and streamline benefits selections. [S049] We continue extending our SMB benefit leadership with Paychex Perks, our award-winning digital marketplace offering affordable, transferable benefits to our clients' employees. [S050] Perks is a compelling growth opportunity that empowers our clients to offer meaningful benefits with no added cost to the employer or administrative burden. [S051] In the first [V015] 18 months, Perks has grown to over [V016] 25 benefit offerings with purchases from nearly [V017] 350,000 unique employees, creating a direct end-user relationship with portable benefits that they can keep if they change employers. [S052] By bringing enterprise-level benefits down market, we are enabling our clients to better compete for talent and addressing a historically underserved market. [S053] The PayCore integration continues to progress well. [S054] We remain on track to exceed our fiscal [V018] 26 synergy targets we discussed last quarter. [S055] Leading indicators such as bookings and broker referrals have re-accelerated to pre-acquisition levels, and we are adding sales headcount to capture the demand we see. [S056] We are gaining momentum cross-selling paychecks ASO, PO, and retirement solutions to PayCore's clients, and we continue to win larger than expected ASO deals and broker-referred PEO opportunities. [S057] This momentum reflects the hard work and alignment of our teams and positions us well going into fiscal year [V019] 27. [S058] Our Paychex Flex and PayCore platforms were recognized as industry-leading HCM solutions with two [V020] 2026 Lighthouse Tech Awards. [S059] This achievement underscores our commitment to empowering businesses with modern, AI-powered solutions that simplify HR processes and drive business outcomes. [S060] Integral to our growth strategy, we continue to accelerate in embedding AI into our workflows. [S061] This amplifies our expertise with human in the loop oversight and strong governance. [S062] We now have over [V021] 500 AI-powered capabilities and agents that can drive higher productivity and smarter decisions and outcomes. [S063] Our generative AI-powered employment law and compliance platform processed tens of thousands of inquiries this quarter, helping clients and paycheck HR experts navigate complex and always changing wage and employment law. [S064] Internally, we are expanding AI use cases to enhance the client experience and sales effectiveness. [S065] Following successful pilots last quarter, we are scaling the use of our voice and email agents for payroll processing, enabling service teams to focus on proactive, higher value advisory support. [S066] We also expanded our agentic AI sales and service tools to the entire sales team with a goal to drive revenue growth and efficiency. [S067] AI agents orchestrated real-time information across service and product systems, equipping thousands of service personnel to support clients more effectively. [S068] This agent swarm architecture really removes prior friction and serves as a foundational capability to future agentic developments. [S069] Our strategic AI investments are bolstering our leadership in HCM innovation. [S070] We are moving from insight and efficiency tools to proactive agents that leverage our vast and growing data set to complete work to drive business success. [S071] Payroll and HR, as we know, are mission critical and highly regulated functions where accuracy and compliance matter more than automation alone. [S072] We believe Paycheck's proprietary payroll data, regulatory expertise, and advisory relationships creates a sustainable advantage that will enable us to respond and responsibly embed AI into our solutions while maintaining a durable competitive mode. [S073] In our business, trust is critical. [S074] It's not just what you do, but it's how you do it that matters to prospects, clients, partners, employees, and key stakeholders. [S075] That's why I'm proud that Paychex was once again named one of the world's most ethical companies by Ethisphere for the [V022] 18th time. [S076] This rare achievement highlights our unwavering commitment to ethical operations and corporate responsibility. [S077] Supporting communities is also integral to our identity, and I am pleased that Paychex was recognized as a leading corporate partner by United Way worldwide reflecting our commitment to making a positive impact where we live and work. [S078] Lastly, I'd like to thank our team for the exceptional hard work during this busy year-end season and through a very, very challenging year of integration. [S079] The work that they've done to support our clients to come together is truly exceptional and I think really is positioning us well as we move into fiscal year [V023] 27. [S080] I will now turn the call over to Bob to discuss our financial results and outlook.

[S081] Bob Schrader [V024] [1046]: Thank you, John. [S082] I'll start with our third quarter financial results, then provide an update on our outlook. [S083] Total revenue increased [V025] 20% over the prior year to [V026] $1.8 billion. [S084] This represents an acceleration in the organic growth of the business relative to the first half of the year. [S085] Management Solutions revenue grew [V027] 23% to [V028] $1.4 billion, driven by product penetration and price realization. [S086] PayCorp contributed approximately [V029] 19 percentage points to growth. [S087] PEO and insurance solutions revenue increased [V030] 9% to [V031] $398 million, driven primarily by strong growth in the number of average PEO worksite employees, as well as an increase in PEO insurance revenues. [S088] Interest on funds held for clients increased [V032] 33% to [V033] $57 million, largely due to the addition of PayCorp balances. [S089] Total expenses increased [V034] 24% to just over [V035] $1 billion, primarily driven by the pay core acquisition. [S090] Excluding a pay core, we estimate that expenses grew in the low single digits during the quarter. [S091] Operating income margin was [V036] 43.8%, and adjusted operating income margins increased approximately [V037] 80 basis points to [V038] 47.7%, driven by increased productivity and cost discipline while increasing our investments in AI. [S092] Diluted earnings per share increased [V039] 9% to [V040] $1.56 per share, and adjusted diluted earnings per share increased [V041] 15% to [V042] $1.71 per share. [S093] Our financial position remains strong with cash, restricted cash, and total corporate investments of [V043] $1.8 billion, and total borrowings of approximately [V044] $5 billion as of the quarter close. [S094] Our cash flow generation continues to be a strength of our model. [S095] Operating cash flows were nearly [V045] $2 billion year-to-date, and our free cash flows increased [V046] 27% year over year. [S096] After the quarter closed, we did repay the initial [V047] $400 million tranche of debt from our OASIS acquisition that matured in March. [S097] Our recent [V048] $1 billion stock repurchase authorization underscores our commitment to delivering long-term shareholder value. [S098] We returned [V049] $463 million this quarter and over [V050] $1.5 billion year to date to shareholders in the form of cash dividends and share buybacks, and our [V051] 12-month rolling return on equity remains robust at [V052] 41%. [S099] Shifting to our guidance for [V053] FY26, which is based on current market conditions, we reaffirm our prior fiscal [V054] 26 outlook, except for raising our interest on funds held for client expectations. [S100] Interest on funds held for clients is now expected to be in the range of [V055] $200 to [V056] $210 million. [S101] All other guidance metrics remain unchanged. [S102] I'm going to turn to the fourth quarter to provide you a little bit of color on the fourth quarter. [S103] We would anticipate fourth quarter growth to be approximately [V057] 12%, with an adjusted operating margin of [V058] 41% to [V059] 42%. [S104] The fourth quarter growth rate reflects a couple of dynamics. [S105] First and foremost, I think most of you know, we anniversary the PACOR acquisition during the quarter. [S106] And to a lesser extent, [V060] Q3 benefited modestly from the timing of certain items relative to [V061] Q4. [S107] However, our second half outlook remains consistent with our expectations in the organic revenue growth acceleration we saw in [V062] Q3. [S108] We believe Paychex has never been better positioned to succeed in the AI era of HCM and deliver shareholder value. [S109] Our business fundamentals remain strong. [S110] As the best operators, we have unrivaled operating and free cash flow margins with an opportunity for further expansion. [S111] Our financial strength and the durability of our business model are evident in our consistent performance as a Rule [V063] 50 company. [S112] We are committed to returning capital to shareholders and confident in our ability to deliver sustained value through continued revenue and earnings growth. [S113] I will now turn the call back over to John for questions. [S114] Thank you, Bob. [S115] We will now open the call to questions.

[S116] Operator [V064] [1301]: Thank you. [S117] If you'd like to ask a question, press star [V065] 1 on your keypad. [S118] To leave the queue at any time, press star [V066] 2. [S119] We do ask that you limit yourself to one question and one follow-up. [S120] Once again, that is star [V067] 1 to ask a question. [S121] And our first question comes from Brian Bergen with TD Cowan. [S122] Your line is now open. [S123] Please go ahead.
